title: [Improvements] Secondary graphs (use same scales if same units on the same graph) and replace Activity by -BGI
symptom: The issue proposes two improvements for secondary graphs: 1) When several curves with same units are in the same subgraph, calculate scale with all values together to allow direct comparison. 2) Replace Insulin Activity in secondary graphs with Blood Glucose Impact (-BGI) because -BGI is more useful for analyzing insulin impact on BG variations, especially with multiple ISF values.
evidence_quote: When several curves with "same units" are in the same subGraph, it could be nice to calculate scale with all values and not separatly
